# CI-only tooling. Runtime deps live in requirements.txt, which every
# consumer's review job installs; nothing here belongs there.
# Pinned: a floating formatter turns the tree red on its own release day.
# A local `pip install -r` picks this up too, so `ruff format` run by a
# contributor matches the version CI checks against.
ruff==0.14.11
# The same reason pins the test runner: CI and a local run share one pytest.
pytest==9.1.1
